import numpy as np
from tslearn.metrics.lcss import njit_lcss_accumulated_matrix

# Prepare small 2D time series (n_timestamps, n_features)
s1_small = s1[:5].reshape(-1, 1).astype(np.float64)
s2_small = s1[:5].reshape(-1, 1).astype(np.float64)

# LCSS uses a mask where finite values indicate valid alignment paths
mask = np.zeros((5, 5), dtype=np.float64)
eps = 0.5

# Compute the accumulated cost matrix
acc_mat = njit_lcss_accumulated_matrix(s1_small, s2_small, eps, mask)

# The accumulated matrix should have an extra row and column for base cases
assert acc_mat.shape == (6, 6), f"Expected shape (6, 6), got {acc_mat.shape}"

# Since s1_small and s2_small are identical, the longest common subsequence length should be 5
lcss_score = acc_mat[-1, -1]
assert lcss_score == 5.0, f"Expected LCSS of 5.0 for identical series, got {lcss_score}"

print(f"__CHECK__ njit_lcss_accumulated_matrix {acc_mat.shape} {lcss_score}")
